algorithms.name: v6_runtime_dynamic_neighborhood
algorithms.description: No-retraining runtime dynamic-neighborhood variant. It keeps the trained DLC world model fixed but rebuilds the local graph at every decision step using interaction-priority neighbor selection. Runtime dynamic graph construction is unbounded: all currently available surrounding vehicles are included, with slot masks for variable cardinality.

algorithms.name: v6_runtime_dynamic_neighborhood_fast
algorithms.description: Latency-oriented v6 variant using the same world model and runtime dynamic-neighborhood construction but a smaller MPC budget. Runtime dynamic graph construction is unbounded: all currently available surrounding vehicles are included, with slot masks for variable cardinality.

algorithms.name: v6_runtime_dynamic_neighborhood_safe
algorithms.description: Safety-oriented v6 variant with a moderate planning budget and stronger risk, lane and grass penalties. Runtime dynamic graph construction is unbounded: all currently available surrounding vehicles are included, with slot masks for variable cardinality. It additionally enables a track-geometry generalization shield that adapts target speed, candidate actions and soft barriers from the local track curvature at runtime without retraining the world model.

algorithms.name: v7_elegance_barrier_dlc_world
algorithms.description: Diagnostic-driven v7 candidate that keeps the DLC world model fixed but adds an explicit soft barrier against grass exposure, large lateral deviation, poor heading and close-gap overtaking during imagined candidate scoring. Runtime dynamic graph construction is unbounded: all currently available surrounding vehicles are included, with slot masks for variable cardinality.
